hero.caption: Union and Confederate positions prior to Union infantry attack in Third Battle of Winchester that occurred September 19, 1864. Confederate (red) units are divisions except Wickham, Lee, and Payne are brigades.The (blue) Union corps (and Crook) consist of two or three divisions each. Wilson is a cavalry division. Arrow points to important Berryville Pike and its "canyon".
